name: Anteats: UCI Dining
subtitle: Menus, campus food & study
promotional_text: Search Anteats or ZotEats. Live UCI dining menus, campus food hours, and library busyness in one app.
description:
Anteats (also searched as ZotEats) is the unofficial UCI dining and campus food app. See what The Anteatery, Brandywine, and Oasis are serving, check campus spots, and find a quiet library.

EAT
• Live menus for The Anteatery and Brandywine, plus Oasis (Coming Soon until menus go live)
• Calories, allergens, and dietary filters (Vegan, Vegetarian, Halal, Kosher, Gluten-Free)
• Browse today and upcoming days; land on Breakfast, Lunch, or Dinner happening now
• Full nutrition on dishes (macros plus expandable label and ingredients)
• Build today's plate with a running calorie and protein tally
• Rate dishes with stars (tap the same star again to clear) and favorite what you want again

CAMPUS
• Hours and open/closed for Starbucks, Panda, Subway, Zot N Go, food courts, and more
• Large filter chips for Open now, Coffee, Food, and Markets
• Retail menus when venues publish them

STUDY
• Library occupancy floor by floor (live Waitz), with a quietest-right-now pick and today's LibCal hours

WIDGETS & MORE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen / StandBy widgets for halls, today's menu, favorites on the board, campus open count / next open, and quietest library
• Live Activity meal countdown on Dynamic Island
• Full dark mode. No accounts. No ads. No tracking.

There is no Gym tab. Unofficial student project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by UC Irvine. Data comes from public campus endpoints that may change.
whats_new: Eat hall tiles are centered and large (Anteatery / Brandywine / Oasis). Campus filter chips are easier to tap. Eat dates sit apart with a stronger selected day. Tap the same star again to clear a rating. Add to Plate is back on dish detail and stays visible. Screenshots match Eat / Campus / Study (no Gym).
review_notes:
No login or account is required. The app reads public endpoints only (Anteater API dining, Dining Hub campus food, Waitz library occupancy, LibCal library hours). Preferences and My Plate stay on-device (UserDefaults / App Group). Privacy Nutrition Label: Data Not Collected; PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is in the app and widget targets.

There is NO Gym tab in this build. ARC gym busyness was removed until live sensors exist. Reviewers should not expect a Gym tab or ARC crowdedness charts.

Demo path for review:
1. Open the Eat tab. Three equal hall tiles (Anteatery, Brandywine, Oasis) with a large centered name and small status. Optional: Filters chip + Clear when filters are on.
2. Tap a dish. Add to Plate is the sticky primary button at the bottom. Favorites heart is secondary. Stars: tap the same star again to clear.
3. Open My Plate via the Plate chip (empty) or tally bar (filled).
4. Campus: large Open now / All / Coffee / Food / Markets chips. Tap any place for the menu sheet or an honest empty/error with Retry.
5. Settings (gear) -> Notifications. Data Sources lists each public feed.
6. Study: quietest library + today's hours (Langson + Science).
7. Optional: Home Screen widgets (Dining Halls, Today's Menu, Favorites Today, Campus Open Now, Quietest Library).

Privacy: Data Not Collected in App Store Connect (must be Published by the account holder). Unofficial student project; not affiliated with UC Irvine.
